confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Los Angeles prices for a July peak-season window; no live listings were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are better grounded than hostel and hotel rates, which vary widely. Cocktail and wine were set using the local beer relationship as a cross-check. The FX value (2026-10-14) came from a search-result snippet of the RBA homepage, not the full RBA table. Third-party quotes for that date are near 0.697, and no later observation was found, so verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No close match in the supplied set. Nara, Manila and Tbilisi are much cheaper, so they were used only to check relative spreads (beer to meal, dorm to private room, basic to three-star hotel). Price levels reflect general knowledge of Los Angeles.
